summary: Answer strict exact RFI and Submittal Cost Impact and Schedule Impact questions locally and ground the same identity, role and complete value in model-generated answers and source findings.
decision_refs: The active objective requires efficient accurate questions across RFI, Submittal and Email content
Printed impact fields are useful workflow facts but must not be replaced by model estimates or calculations
The existing workflow index and immutable evidence can answer exact labelled fields without a second index or provider cost
approval_evidence: The persistent objective authorizes bounded efficiency, accuracy and adaptability improvements across RFI, Submittal and Email question flows.
known_limitations: Only strict English questions naming one exact RFI or Submittal and one supported printed impact field use the local shortcut.
Email-prefixed fields, headers, quoted history, signatures, ordinary cost or delay prose and unlabeled text remain outside the field contract.
More than 32 primary files or candidate passages and conflicting explicit values fail closed.
The implementation does not estimate, calculate, convert, predict or infer cost, duration, applicability, responsibility, approval, chronology, authority or contractual effect.
